scope_description.value: Remove existing Boiler #108 (Nebraska 'D' type water tube boiler, Cleaver Brooks/Nebraska Model# 2D 2056) from Portsmouth Naval Medical Center Central Steam Plant (Building 20) and install a new 30,000 lb/hr package water tube boiler. Provide associated mechanical and electrical work to connect new boiler to existing systems. New boiler to operate with existing boilers 109 and 110 for n+1 redundancy.
scope_description.quote: This project will remove the aging Boiler #108 from the Portsmouth Naval Medical Center Central Steam plant and replace it with a new lower maintenance and higher efficiency boiler. This existing Nebraska "D" type water tube boiler [Cleaver Brooks/Nebraska Model# 2D 2056/ 20,000 lb} would be removed in its entirety and the systems and structures that remain will be prepped, repaired or replaced to receive a new 30,000 lb/hr package water tube boiler. This new water tube boiler shall be sized to export 30,000 lb/hr (steam) and system designed to operate in conjunction with the existing, larger boilers 109 and 110 to obtain a true n+1 redundancy.

conflict_flags.rationale: BOD is the later document (April 2021 vs. December 2019 SAES) and is the design-team-authored technical document. The SAES was the pre-design scope document; the BOD reflects the actual design decision. Water tube boiler is the authoritative specification.

BOD is the authoritative design document. The 30,000 lb figure in the SAES may be a data entry error or confusion with the new boiler's target capacity. BOD clearly distinguishes existing (20,000 lb) from new (30,000 lb/hr).
